userDecision: Prepare implementation first. Do not send GitHub Support a message.

architecture.codespaces: Development container with Ubuntu 24.04, Python, GitHub CLI and checksum-pinned Foundation 12. No public application server or privileged container configuration.
architecture.actions: One manual repository development workflow for two immutable software benchmark fixtures. Disabled unless the owner explicitly sets CFD_DEVELOPMENT_JOBS_ENABLED=true.
architecture.connector: Server-side standard-library Python adapter: prepare, dispatch, reconcile, status, cancel and verified artifact retrieval. No HTTP endpoint is exposed.
architecture.calculationAuthority: Unmodified pinned Python OpenFOAM worker. This adapter performs no engineering calculation and writes nothing to Main.
architecture.mainAndIndependentPythonLabs: No runtime source, equations or routes changed by this preparation.

sourceBindings.dispatchRef: Reviewed lightweight tag cfd-dev-<40-character support commit>, verified through Git refs before dispatch.
sourceBindings.operatingSystem: Ubuntu 24.04 image and packages receive security updates; only the solver archive and source commits are byte-pinned.

jobLifecycle: Prepare a token-free request binding: unique request ID, allowlisted case profile, exact source commit.
Verify the reviewed tag target and dispatch once; CLI creates an exclusive attempt receipt before contacting GitHub.
Persist the returned run ID where available. After uncertainty, reconcile the same ID; never automatically dispatch again.
Poll queued/running status and known stage labels. No estimated percentage is invented.
Cancellation remains requested until GitHub reports cancelled or another terminal state.
Workflow success means ResultAvailable. Only a matching validated numerical report is returned as a verified benchmark result.
Download one bounded result.json in memory. Bind request, run, source commits, fixture hashes and exact numerical flags; do not extract arbitrary archive paths.

credentialsAndIsolation.credentialLocation: Trusted backend process only; CLI reads GH_TOKEN from its environment. No token is stored in a request, artifact, browser or source file.
credentialsAndIsolation.recommendedCredential: Repository-limited GitHub App installation token: Actions write, Contents read. Installation and token issuance are not implemented or configured here.
credentialsAndIsolation.download: GitHub API authorization is never forwarded to artifact storage. Only one HTTPS redirect to GitHub Actions/Azure artifact storage is accepted.
credentialsAndIsolation.source: Checkout credentials are not persisted; public pinned submodules remain unchanged. No arbitrary commands, URLs, files, geometry or student study payloads are accepted.
credentialsAndIsolation.limits: 30-minute workflow timeout; native worker timeout 1200 seconds, aggregate memory 2 GiB, CPU quota 100%, 32 tasks, 256 MiB workspace watchdog and bounded logs. Native execution requires delegated cgroup v2.
credentialsAndIsolation.retention: Uploaded result artifact retained one day. No automatic rerun or old-result fallback.
credentialsAndIsolation.codespaces: Post-create provisioning does not start a service or solver. A standard Codespace may lack delegated cgroup limits; installing OpenFOAM alone must not bypass that gate.

developmentRunProcedureAfterReview: Publish the reviewed support change and create its exact lightweight cfd-dev-<commit> tag. Neither publication nor tag creation has been performed by this preparation.
For repository development verification, deliberately enable CFD_DEVELOPMENT_JOBS_ENABLED. Keep the public application disconnected.
Set GITHUB_CFD_APPROVED_COMMIT in the trusted caller to that exact reviewed commit. Supply a repository-scoped token through the environment without writing it to a file or chat.
Optional cancellation: python -B tools/github_cfd_job.py cancel --request outputs/request.json. Poll status afterwards.
Preserve request and dispatch receipts after uncertain delivery. Do not delete the attempt marker to force an automatic retry.
remainingAcceptance: Run the new workflow in GitHub and verify real queued/running/cancelled/completed states, delegated resource caps, artifact download/digest and numerical report for both fixtures.

Create a Codespace for actual devcontainer build/provisioning acceptance, inspect its capability report and measure real quota use. Container build and Codespace creation have not been performed locally.
Implement per-student authentication/ownership, durable job/run binding, admission control, quotas, rate limits and queue fairness before a multi-user application integration.
Build the Python adapter from actual student study inputs to a validated native case. The two fixed benchmarks do not simulate an arbitrary pump and cannot substitute for a student's result.
Integrate Lab Run/progress/results without exposing GitHub credentials. Do not alter the independent NPSHr/Transient calculation routes.
Resolve the published GitHub production-hosting constraints before activating the proposed public production backend. No support exception has been requested or obtained.
Experimental validation requires actual measured data with configuration, units, datum and uncertainty; none have been invented.
